rationale: ItNet-style iterative recon with data consistency (Sidky 2022 winner approach). Pretrained U-Net + 5 DC iterations. Underperforms on synthetic data - needs investigation.
advice_for_others: Naive ItNet: headroom=0 on synthetic phantoms. Likely issues: (1) DC gradient step too aggressive, (2) pretraining on noisy FBP poor, (3) needs proper geometry estimation. Real challenge data may behave differently.
